title: Multi-omics integration reveals ANXA6-high gammadelta T cell-endothelial communication as a potential link between periodontitis and MASLD.
authors: Zhang, Zhongxuan; Ma, Zihan; Zhang, Ruidong; Ye, Min; Shi, Zhongyu; Yu, Miao; Ou, Lingling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学整合分析探究牙周炎与MASLD共病的免疫机制，虽涉及转录因子调控分析，但核心是疾病关联与细胞通讯，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合。
abstract: Periodontitis (PD) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) were highly prevalent inflammatory disorders that frequently coexisted, yet the molecular basis of their comorbidity remained poorly defined. Here, we applied an integrative multi-omics strategy that combined bulk RNA sequencing, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, spatial transcriptomics, single-cell profiling, and machine learning. This approach identified 11 hub genes bridging immune activation and metabolic remodeling, among which Annexin A6 (ANXA6) emerged as a key cross-disease candidate. Spatial transcriptomics supported tissue-specific localization of the hub-gene signature, while single-cell analysis revealed selective enrichment of ANXA6 expression in gammadelta T cells. Notably, ANXA6-high gammadelta T cells exhibited enhanced signaling interactions with endothelial cells, suggesting immune-vascular crosstalk in PD-MASLD comorbidity. Upstream regulatory analysis further highlighted transcription factors associated with ANXA6 expression, and Connectivity Map-based prediction suggested candidate compounds with the potential to reverse ANXA6-associated transcriptional programs. Collectively, these findings support the hypothesis that ANXA6-high gammadelta T cell-endothelial communication represents a shared immunological feature of PD-MASLD comorbidity, offering novel insights into common immune programs and potential therapeutic opportunities.
abstract_zh: 牙周炎（PD）与代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）是高度流行的炎症性疾病，常同时存在，然而其共病的分子基础仍不明确。在此，我们采用了一种整合性多组学策略，结合了批量RNA测序、加权基因共表达网络分析、空间转录组学、单细胞分析和机器学习。该方法识别出11个连接免疫激活与代谢重塑的核心基因，其中膜联蛋白A6（ANXA6）脱颖而出，成为跨疾病的关键候选基因。空间转录组学支持核心基因特征的组织特异性定位，而单细胞分析揭示了ANXA6表达在γδ T细胞中的选择性富集。值得注意的是，高表达ANXA6的γδ T细胞与内皮细胞表现出增强的信号相互作用，提示PD-MASLD共病中存在免疫-血管串扰。上游调控分析进一步突出了与ANXA6表达相关的转录因子，基于Connectivity Map的预测则提出了可能逆转ANXA6相关转录程序的候选化合物。总体而言，这些发现支持高表达ANXA6的γδ T细胞-内皮细胞通讯代表PD-MASLD共病共享免疫特征的假说，为共同免疫程序及潜在治疗机会提供了新见解。
